title: Amazing
body: The app is well thought off; very insightful pieces to keep one going
author: sammy- bw

title: Love it
body: It can be a bit confusing with a lot going on. Which is why I only have it 4 stars, but I absolutely love it. It really helps me stay on track to be a better me. I love the bedtime memos and adding of daily habits slowly.
author: Sal Tuzo

title: For the Procrastinators
body: So this app has me doing things that I like to procrastinate; that work project that was looming over my head and exercise!  So far, I love this thing!
author: Bermy-gal
